pr_title: Augment the `InputEvent` class with a `CANCELED` state
pr_body:
The `InputEvent` class currently supports the `pressed` and `released` states, which given the binary nature, is represented by a `bool` field. 
This PR introduces the `CANCELED` state, which signals that an ongoing input event has been canceled. 
To represent all the states, the `InputEventState` enum is added and the `InputEvent` logic is refactored accordingly.

Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/75144
Address https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/74199

[3.x version](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/76715)

<!--
Please target the `master` branch in priority.
PRs can target `3.x` if the same change was done in `master`, or is not relevant there.

Relevant fixes are cherry-picked for stable branches as needed by maintainers.
You can mention in the description if the change is compatible with `3.x`.
-->
pr_comments:
Thanks :)
I'd like @reduz to sign off on the change before we merge as it's a core change to how we think of input events.

I think changing API for this is not justified. This is a very corner case situation that may affect a tiny amount of controls. Forcing everything else to be able to be aware of a cancelled state via the enum just makes the API more confusing.

My suggestion is to simply add a `bool InputEvent::was_cancelled() const` function so any interested control/user can make use it, otherwise ignore it.

> My suggestion is to simply add a `bool InputEvent::was_cancelled() const` function so any interested control/user can make use it, otherwise ignore it.

@reduz, I've updated the PR to address the feedback.

This seems like a pretty significant change to cherry-pick. It affects such things as how event status is resolved and how events are serialized to strings. As such we discussed it, and decided to avoid picking it. Please consider updating to 4.1 when it's available.

issue_context.title: Cannot use curve menus on points in the Godot Android editor
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0 - android

### System information

Android 13, Samsung Galaxy 7 FE

### Issue description

It's not possible to bring up the right click menus for the 1D cruve resource editor on the android build. Double tap and log tap don't work.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7917475/226368446-2c245099-f2af-4922-9a3f-ab22b50cf825.png)


### Steps to reproduce

Create a new curve resource in the android editor, then try to add points or right click the points

### Minimal reproduction project

see above.

review_comments: Is there a reason for the `InputEventShortcut` to be in the `pressed` state?

I don't know for sure, but I guess it's because they are not actual input events and a conceptual decision had to be made about whether to consider such a fake event type as pressed or not, with the former making the most sense.

With the refactor, its state should be `NONE` (or `DEFAULT` depending on what we settle on) which would change `is_pressed()` result to `false`.
I'll go ahead with that update, and can always revert if that breaks some underlying assumption.
Let me suggest making these a bit field, or use a hand-crafted enum + flags construct. Due to alignment, maybe we wouldn't be gaining in terms of object size, though.
